summary: Code review and bug fix completed for 3 new features: 1) MapView trash button in side panel, 2) Pipeline visibility toggle on deal cards, 3) Map marker anchor fix. Found and fixed critical bug: StageColumn was not passing onToggleVisibility prop to DealCard. Also fixed duplicate export at end of Pipeline.js.

mapview_trash_button_visible.details: Lines 1800-1816: Trash button with data-testid='side-panel-delete-deal' visible in side panel header next to close (X) button

mapview_trash_button_hidden_for_team_dea.details: Line 1801: Conditional {!selectedDeal.isTeamDeal && (...)} ensures trash button NOT visible for team deals

mapview_trash_confirmation_and_delete.details: Lines 893-910: handleDeleteSelectedDeal uses window.confirm() for confirmation, then DELETE /api/deals/:id, then removes from local state via setDeals filter

pipeline_visibility_toggle_ui.details: Lines 170-190: DealCard has visibility toggle with data-testid='visibility-toggle-${deal.id}', Users icon, shows 'Shared' (green) when team_id set, 'Private' (grey) when null

pipeline_visibility_toggle_api.details: Lines 617-631: handleToggleDealVisibility calls PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility with {shared_with_team: bool}, updates deal.team_id in local state

pipeline_visibility_prop_passing.details: Line 358: StageColumn now passes onToggleVisibility={onToggleVisibility} to DealCard - was missing before fix

mapview_marker_anchor_bottom.details: Lines 1017, 1035: Both user markers and team markers use anchor='bottom' for proper teardrop pin positioning

mapview_overflow_css.details: Lines 2428-2434: CSS includes .maplibregl-marker and .maplibregl-canvas-container with overflow: visible !important to prevent edge clipping

missing_onToggleVisibility_prop.issue: StageColumn component received onToggleVisibility prop but did not pass it to DealCard, causing visibility toggle button to fail
missing_onToggleVisibility_prop.fix: Added onToggleVisibility={onToggleVisibility} to DealCard props in StageColumn

duplicate_export.issue: Duplicate 'export default Pipeline;' and extra closing braces at end of file
duplicate_export.fix: Removed duplicate code, kept single export statement

critical_code_review_comments: MapView.js: Trash button correctly gated by !selectedDeal.isTeamDeal - only deal owners can delete
MapView.js: handleDeleteSelectedDeal properly uses window.confirm() and optimistic local state update
Pipeline.js: Visibility toggle UI correctly shows green 'Shared' vs grey 'Private' based on team_id
Pipeline.js: handleToggleDealVisibility correctly calls PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility endpoint
MapView.js: Marker anchor='bottom' ensures teardrop pins point to exact location
MapView.js: CSS overflow:visible prevents marker clipping at map edges

success_rate.frontend: 100% code review passed (8/8 features verified, 2 bugs fixed)

test_credentials.note: App uses Supabase auth. No test credentials available. Code review performed instead of E2E testing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three features verified: 1) MapView.js trash button (lines 1800-1816) with handleDeleteSelectedDeal (lines 893-910) - only shows for own deals, uses window.confirm. 2) Pipeline.js visibility toggle on DealCard (lines 170-190) with handleToggleDealVisibility (lines 617-631) - calls PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility. Fixed missing onToggleVisibility prop passing in StageColumn. 3) MapView.js marker anchor='bottom' (lines 1017, 1035) and CSS overflow:visible (lines 2428-2434) for edge clipping fix. App requires Supabase auth.

bug_1_missing_prop.root_cause: StageColumn component destructured onToggleVisibility from props but never passed it to DealCard children
bug_1_missing_prop.fix: Added onToggleVisibility={onToggleVisibility} to DealCard props in StageColumn render
bug_1_missing_prop.impact: Without fix, clicking visibility toggle on Pipeline cards would throw 'onToggleVisibility is not a function' error

bug_2_duplicate_export.root_cause: Copy-paste error left duplicate closing braces and export statement at end of file
bug_2_duplicate_export.impact: Would cause syntax error on build
